name: agv-map-editor
description: Editor for AGV floor maps: React and TypeScript front end, Express API, one Docker image.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
